title_cn: 新研究显示约翰内斯堡陷入“债务末日循环”
summary: The City of Johannesburg is stuck in a “debt doom loop,” because its failure to collect outstanding obligations has forced it to raise tariffs to the point where fewer and fewer customers are willing or able to pay for services, a new study has found.

title: Iran’s Ex-Spymaster Returns to Build a Bottom-Up Security State
title_cn: 伊朗前间谍头子回归建立自下而上的安全国家
summary: Hossein Taeb built a reputation for ruthlessness over a four-decade career in Iran’s post-revolution security apparatus. After a break from the public eye, he’s back, reprising his former job as head of the country’s powerful volunteer militia, the Basij.
